concerns.text: FR‑005 requires computing a Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) for each predictor and skipping univariate testing for any predictor with VIF ≥ 5.0. VIF is defined only for a set of predictors in a multiple‑regression context; it is not meaningful for a single predictor in a separate partial‑correlation analysis. Using VIF to decide whether to run a univariate correlation is a methodological misuse.

The specification assumes that the Human Connectome Project (HCP) 1200 Subjects Release can be freely downloaded on the CI platform (see Assumptions). In practice HCP data require registration and cannot be accessed without credentials, and the fallback OpenNeuro dataset lacks diffusion tractography. This makes the core structural‑functional analysis infeasible, undermining the scientific validity of the study.
